name: astro-coach
install: python3 -m venv python-service/.venv && python-service/.venv/bin/pip install -U pip && python-service/.venv/bin/pip install -r python-service/requirements-dev.txt && (cd astro-coach && npm install)

terminals.name: ephemeris-uvicorn
terminals.description: Python FastAPI ephemeris sidecar. Next defaults EPHEMERIS_SERVICE_URL to http://127.0.0.1:8000. start.sh will skip starting a second copy if /health is already up. Shared secret is optional in Cloud Agent; required in Docker/production (EPHEMERIS_REQUIRE_SECRET=1).
